title: Relative lifting and classification of strong monoidal operation morphisms
statement:
Use the monoidal infinity-category convention of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category] and the projection-pullback and planar-operation data of [lem-coef-monoidal-block-projection-coherence]. For two monoidal infinity categories with underlying unital planar operation systems $(A,t_r)$ and $(B,u_r)$, let $\operatorname{OpMor}(A,B)$ be the infinity category whose objects are a coherent functor $f:A\to B$ and equivalences $f t_r\simeq u_r f^r$ for every $r\geq0$, compatible with all planar substitution, unit, and higher tree simplices, and whose morphisms are transformations with these same coherences. The construction sending a strong monoidal functor over $N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$ to its underlying functor and operation comparisons is an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Fun}^{\otimes}_{\mathrm{str}}(A^\otimes,B^\otimes)\simeq\operatorname{OpMor}(A,B).$$
Moreover, let $j:C\to T$ and $k:D\to Z$ be relative cocompletions with restriction equivalences for all finite arities as in [lem-coef-relative-planar-operation-extension], and suppose a relation-preserving coherent $b:C\to D$ with a planar operation morphism to the operation system on $D$ is given. The unary restriction equivalence extends $b$ to a colimit-preserving $\bar b:T\to Z$; the finite-arity restriction equivalences lift all operation comparisons, inverses, transformations, and higher compatibility simplices to a unique (contractible-choice) object of $\operatorname{OpMor}(T,Z)$. Under the displayed equivalence this object is exactly a strong monoidal $\bar b$, and restriction gives an equivalence on the full infinity categories of such strong monoidal functors, including all mapping spaces.
